Existing frozen copies must remain immutable; root edits alone do not update bundles if a version-local copy exists.

One training route constructs the model, Trainer, per-seed/LR trials, dev histories, selected checkpoints and manifests. Extend this route with explicit versioned condition configuration; do not create a parallel train_v05.py or notebook-only loop.

Reuse exact text-only encoding, no truncation, same padding and deterministic inference path. evaluate_checkpoint works with any saved checkpoint whose label mapping and model class remain compatible.

Existing dev-only selection and metrics are reusable. More than one method makes current (seed,LR) uniqueness insufficient; either run each method through unchanged selector and compare prespecified dev means, or generalize its condition identity while retaining a backward-compatible wrapper. Do not replace the selection rule opportunistically after results.

Reuse hashes, byte preservation, predictions, label maps, checkpoint shapes, best-epoch replay and metrics. Extend condition identity, counts, outcome roles and manifest checks together with training code.

Reuse deterministic input bundle, fresh runtime/output refusal, pinned environment, integrity checks, train invocation, verification and archive packing. Parameterize names and trial/model counts for new method experiments.

current_training.train_loss: Default unweighted single-label cross entropy from sequence-classification model/Trainer. No custom compute_loss, class weights, weighted sampler, augmentation or label smoothing in current source.
current_training.selection: Each seed/LR best epoch by dev macro-F1 over all 19 labels; tie lower dev loss then earlier epoch then earlier trial index. Select one shared LR by the mean best-dev metrics across all three seeds. Select one primary seed from those three on dev by same ordering; freeze before test predictions. Selected v0.4 LR=5e-5, primary seed44; selected epochs 7/8/7.

critical_extension_constraints.finding: All four actual dropout probabilities are zero. Two ordinary training forwards have no deliberately enabled dropout perturbation; adding R-Drop KL alone would be degenerate (up to backend nondeterminism). Explicit nonzero dropout is a separate intervention. A dropout-only matched control is necessary to isolate the KL contribution. Set actual ModernBERT configuration fields before construction and verify instantiated dropout modules plus saved config.

Dev loss is a selection tie-break and is required to reproduce after checkpoint reload (train.py:276-286, verify_results.py:311-314). Training-only auxiliary losses should return ordinary one-pass unweighted CE in eval mode. Otherwise the raw Trainer in evaluate_checkpoint reports different loss. Keep train objective and evaluation CE separately named and logged.

TrainingArguments label_smoothing_factor applies Trainer loss computation during evaluation too, while evaluate_checkpoint constructs fresh arguments with smoothing=0. Merely enabling that existing argument breaks current reload-loss contract. Implement training-only smoothing in the same custom loss hook or deliberately share eval-loss policy; do not silently drop the check.

v0.4 test73 was fully inspected. For every future adaptation it is regression-only, including if same file name test is retained for compatibility. New metadata/reporting must say regression and must not issue a fresh independent 95% acceptance claim. Existing config primary_selection causes target_assessment automatically, so disentangle model selection from independent acceptance eligibility.

v03_data.lineage_config currently requires old dev/test mapping to legacy and fresh train/dev/test names. Blindly advancing dataset lineage for a training-method-only comparison forces needless new holdouts. Reuse unchanged v0.4 dataset lineage and hashes, version the methodology separately, and add explicit evaluation roles/independent evaluation pending. Do not manufacture synthetic test rows to satisfy the schema or target.

MeasuredTrainer timing must be retained when introducing loss or optimizer modifications. SAM-like second passes alter compute and scheduler/optimizer semantics. Preserve synchronized wall time and peak GPU memory and disclose extra training compute.

verify_results.py:175 hardcodes six histories; build_colab.py:116,132 assumes six trials and pack:139 three selected models; markdown:449 fixed seeds. method_extension_options_not_recommendat.location: MeasuredTrainer.compute_loss (new override on existing trainer); model construction at train.py:413-421

method_extension_options_not_recommendat.minimal_shape: Two stochastic forwards on the same text batch; mean CE plus coefficient times symmetric KL using stable log-softmax; no metadata input. In eval use one forward and ordinary CE. Preserve return_outputs contract. Validate coefficient and reduction convention in config.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.controls: Baseline CE/no-dropout; CE with exactly same enabled dropout; R-Drop with that dropout, same seed/LR/epochs/batch. If parent chooses it, document method formula and actual dropout sites.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.test_needs: Zero coefficient equivalence to declared CE path; KL zero at equal logits; symmetry/nonnegativity tolerance; finite logits/gradients; different stochastic outputs with dropout enabled; eval deterministic single forward and reload CE equality.

method_extension_options_not_recommendat.location: Same trainer compute_loss override; TrainingArguments hook exists but eval caution above
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.minimal_shape: Configured epsilon in training CE only; raw labels and 19-class mapping remain unchanged; eval ordinary CE.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.controls: Same dropout/optimizer/batches as baseline so smoothing is the only intentional difference.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.test_needs: epsilon=0 equivalent to baseline CE; valid epsilon bounds; known hand-computed loss; no smoothing in evaluation; finite gradients.

method_extension_options_not_recommendat.location: Same trainer loss override plus existing model hidden representations; evaluate_checkpoint must still reload standard classifier
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.type: representation auxiliary loss, possibly sampler/representation changes
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.minimal_shape: Derive documented pooled hidden representation with attention-mask handling; normalize embeddings and compute same-label positives excluding self; combine with CE. Avoid adding a new inference head unless serialization and verification are explicitly extended. Batch16 is smaller than 19 classes, so positive availability cannot be assumed.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.controls: If using multi-view dropout, matched dropout-only control; if using class-aware batching, matched sampler-only control or explicitly separate factor.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.test_needs: No-positive and singleton batch cases; no self-positive; positive/negative masks; padding-safe pooling; temperature bounds; finite gradients; output predictions remain logits rather than tuple/hidden-state outputs.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.risks: Requires output_hidden_states or equivalent observed model output support; compute_metrics and prediction_rows currently assume numpy [N,19] logits. Verify current Transformers API before implementation.

method_extension_options_not_recommendat.location: Model construction before Trainer creation; potential reparameterization of eligible linear weights
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.type: parameter regularization/model surgery rather than only scalar loss
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.minimal_shape: Fix documented reference parameters from pretrained initialization, with explicit policy for randomly initialized classifier; mix specified weights during training and restore ordinary inference representation for save/reload.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.controls: Document probability and layer coverage; keep optimizer and all other factors fixed.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.test_needs: p=0 identity; inference identity; reference weights remain fixed; serialization is standard/reload equivalent; no incompatible tensor names/shapes.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.risks: Saved checkpoints are checked for classifier.weight shape, all-F32 dtype and parameter count. Persistent reference buffers/custom modules can break parameter accounting and standard AutoModel reload.

method_extension_options_not_recommendat.location: Existing trainer optimizer creation/training_step extension, not an auxiliary loss-only hook
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.minimal_shape: Two forward/backward passes around a reversible parameter perturbation; one actual base optimizer and scheduler update per logical step; restore weights in all exit paths; preserve callback semantics.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.controls: Same AdamW base parameters, LR schedule, initialization, data order and step count; report ~two-pass compute rather than comparing only epochs.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.test_needs: Parameter restoration including failure; zero-norm guard; perturbation norm; exactly one optimizer/scheduler step; clipping and grad accumulation ordering; finite gradients; correct save state.
method_extension_options_not_recommendat.risks: High coupling to Transformers/Accelerate 5.19/1.15 loop. Gradient accumulation=1 reduces but does not remove integration complexity; avoid treating optimizer swap as equivalent in complexity to label smoothing/R-Drop.

dataset_audit.interpretation: Current train is 1296 examples with label counts36-171 and 58 families. Dev68 and test73 are entirely Codex synthetic with 2-8 and 2-6 examples/class respectively. They measure this curated text distribution; raw MASSIVE localized examples in old splits do not make new dev/test independent real-use speech. No existing class weighting or balancing is applied despite imbalance.
checks: dataset.model_example exposes text and integer label only (dataset.py:94-96).

dataset.validate/v03_data.validate_v03 preserve original rows, label IDs, assignment, group/family constraints, normalized duplicates, source SHA, public official partition and train-only derivations.
test_v04_pipeline.py prevents prior holdout migration into train and checks frozen prediction comparisons on identical text/gold.
Training captures input/data hashes before and after all runs; refuses existing output/report directories.
dataset_audit.known_test_policy: Retain v0.4 test bytes and all older evaluations for diagnostic regression only; no selection, tuning or acceptance on them. Use same train/dev for controlled method comparison. Hold out future independent real utterances prospectively; absent here and pending. Do not generate replacement synthetic holdouts to chase95.

controlled_comparison_design: Freeze experiment definition and baseline before any run: identical v0.4 train/dev hashes, tokenizer/model revision, label contract, preprocessing, 42/43/44 seeds, float32/SDPA, epoch limit, batch16, no truncation.

Prefer a fresh CE baseline in the same run/environment to control method effects; prior saved baseline is historical reference. If comparing only fixed LR5e-5, call it a fixed-LR ablation and state applicability; if comparing tuned procedures, give every method the same predeclared LR grid [2e-5,5e-5] and the same dev-only selection procedure.

Limit method/coefficient combinations beforehand; dev68 is small and repeated trials overfit selection. Present per-seed and mean/stddev paired method differences. Three seeds are not an independent sample-size enlargement of test73, and their SD is not a confidence interval.

Retain primary seed selection only as dev-selected deployment candidate metadata, not proof of improvement. Report all three selected seeds for every method and regression direction counts, class supports and source/family metrics.

Represent test73/older splits as regression-only in config, manifest and reports; independent_real_utterance_evaluation=pending and acceptance_eligible=false. Disable misleading target assessment for these experiments while keeping old v0.4 artifacts/verifier immutable.

Use a new versioned methodology experiment root/bundle with explicit frozen shared-code copies and exact copies of current data, or add an explicit read-only dataset reference with matching manifest semantics. Avoid running data preparation to rewrite/repartition unchanged data.
No new prompts, label descriptions, relabeling, data augmentation, thresholding, production adoption or application dispatch belongs in this training-method-only comparison.
testing_requirements_before_delivery: Run current data/metrics suites against unchanged root baseline and fixed v0.3/v0.4 copies, using their frozen source where relevant; old fixtures remain unchanged.

Add focused loss or optimizer tests only for selected scientific method; no training needed for algebra/serialization-independent unit cases. Verify baseline default path remains standard Trainer behavior.

Test method-condition uniqueness, missing/duplicate combinations, dev-only selection/tie breaks and rejection of test-based selection; method metadata must survive callbacks, histories and verifier recomputation.
Test acceptance eligibility gate: known v0.4 test can never produce independent goal-met claim, regardless of accuracy. No need for fresh synthetic examples.
Test new bundle contains all new code and config, names/counts derive from experiment, no old artifact overwritten; compile generated notebook cells and run frozen-data/hash validations.

Before launching full authorized comparison, verify actual model dropout/optimizer settings and evaluation CE/reload equality on proportionate integration check. Do not claim training results from unit checks. Preserve standard checkpoint save/reload with label mapping and parameter count checks.
Hash old data, model artifacts, fixed code and results before/after preparation/integration. Required checkpoint commit only parent after diff review and proportionate checks.
unverified_boundaries: No method implementation, local package API inspection, model inference, training, network access, installation or tests were performed.
AdamW grouping exclusions were not inspected in installed Transformers source; current TrainingArguments and selected hyperparameters are directly confirmed.
This audit proposes implementation boundaries, not a literature-backed scientific choice or expected accuracy gain.

architecture_comparison.recommended_for_minimal_change: Separate immutable experiment root for each condition, each running the same shared train.py and the existing 3 seeds x 2 LRs = 6 trials. Add a thin comparison/orchestration layer that never implements model training itself.

condition_roots.reuse: One identical training implementation plus one explicit condition config in each root; preserve dataset version4, all v0.4 source/data/plan bytes and role metadata. Freeze the same new shared-code version into each new bundle; do not change archived v0.4 files. Existing tests work against each root because dataset remains unchanged.
condition_roots.selection: Keep select_shared_learning_rate unchanged within each root. Compute prespecified cross-method ranking from the mean best-dev macro F1 for the selected LR (or other fully predeclared rule), using only selection.json files. Never rank by best individual seed or regression metrics. A method comparison reporter is not a duplicate training route.
advantages: Existing exact (seed,LR) grid validation still applies without extending key shape.
Trial1-6, saved seed42-44 paths, callback, verifier loop and pack expectations remain valid within each root.
Each condition can be independently verified, rerun into a fresh root and archived; partial failures do not invalidate completed other conditions.
Loss/model changes remain in one shared trainer/model factory.
required_small_changes: Explicit validated method/dropout/loss config and saved effective values in shared train.py.
Unambiguous experiment/bundle/remote directory/result names per condition; current build_colab.py V04 constants would collide in one Colab runtime.
New evaluation-role gate so old test73 is regression-only and independent acceptance remains pending.
A bounded batch runner may invoke the exact existing train.py command per condition ROOT, then invoke the same verifier. It must not reimplement the train loop.
Comparison verifier checks consistent baseline fields/hashes, shared implementation and complete method set before comparing dev means.
condition_roots.caveat: Current train.py predicts all splits after selection inside each condition. It does not freeze cross-method choice before any condition test prediction. Because v0.4 test is already known regression data, this is not an independent test. For a mechanically enforced global no-regression-prediction-before-method-choice rule, add a shared deferred-evaluation phase; otherwise predeclare all conditions and make cross-method ranking consume only dev selection records, then report regression separately. Do not claim existing code enforces global condition selection timing.

required_changes: Change SaveBestDevelopment metadata, trial directory and history naming, selection return schema and primary candidate naming.
Extend verify_results exact grid and per-condition history/checkpoint/prediction associations.

Preserve old function signatures or use frozen old verifiers for historical artifacts.

gaps_to_close_for_new_method_comparison: Condition identity must be unique and validated against a predeclared list. A repeated baseline under two aliases is not an independent method. Reject unknown/inapplicable parameters rather than silently ignore them.

Compare all condition data hashes, source label contract hash, model revision, tokenizer/max length, epochs, batch size, seeds, LR grid, dtype/attention, optimizer hyperparameters and selection rule. Whitelist only the intended method fields as differences.

Method effect claims need same seeds paired and complete results from all prespecified conditions; do not omit failed or unfavorable runs. Three seeds and 68 dev examples constrain confidence.

A scalar loss coefficient has no meaning without formula/reduction. Explicitly record CE averaging, symmetric-KL direction average, batch/class reduction, dropout sites, and label-smoothing policy so a nominal alpha is reproducible.
